t=df['t'].values; A=df['A'].values; r=df['dA_dt'].values
knots=np.linspace(0.5,10,11)
def hat(x):
    B=[]
    for i,k in enumerate(knots):
        h=np.zeros_like(x)
        if i>0:
            m=(x>=knots[i-1])&(x<=k); h[m]=(x[m]-knots[i-1])/(k-knots[i-1])
        if i<len(knots)-1:
            m=(x>k)&(x<=knots[i+1]); h[m]=(knots[i+1]-x[m])/(knots[i+1]-k)
        B.append(h)
    return np.vstack(B).T
